主要内容: Brookfield Asset Management Inc. announced the notice of its Annual Meeting of Shareholders and the availability of investor materials dated March 20, 2015. The meeting was scheduled to take place on the same date. A.J. Silber, Corporate Secretary, signed the report on behalf of the company. The document includes details about the meeting and related investor materials. The filing was made under Regulation S-T and is part of the company's compliance with the Securities Exchange Act of 1934. The company is a financial services firm based in Toronto, Canada, with its principal executive offices at Suite 300, Brookfield Place, 181 Bay Street, P.O. Box 762, Toronto, Canada M5J 2T3. The filing is part of the company's ongoing reporting obligations under U.S. securities regulations.
